Benford’s Law: https://t.co/OjP2EEtxUo

Fraud detection is just one of its many practical powerful applications!

Amazon Summary:

“This book provides the first comprehensive treatment of Benford's law, the surprising logarithmic distribution of significant digits discovered in the late nineteenth century. Establishing the mathematical and statistical principles that underpin this intriguing phenomenon, the text combines up-to-date theoretical results with overviews of the law’s colorful history, rapidly growing body of empirical evidence, and wide range of applications.

An Introduction to Benford’s Law begins with basic facts about significant digits, Benford functions, sequences, and random variables, including tools from the theory of uniform distribution. After introducing the scale-, base-, and sum-invariance characterizations of the law, the book develops the significant-digit properties of both deterministic and stochastic processes, such as iterations of functions, powers of matrices, differential equations, and products, powers, and mixtures of random variables. Two concluding chapters survey the finitely additive theory and the flourishing applications of Benford’s law.

Carefully selected diagrams, tables, and close to 150 examples illuminate the main concepts throughout. The text includes many open problems, in addition to dozens of new basic theorems and all the main references. A distinguishing feature is the emphasis on the surprising ubiquity and robustness of the significant-digit law. This text can serve as both a primary reference and a basis for seminars and courses.”

fullText:
英伟达开源的一个能理解企业数据的AI语义大脑：Auto Ontology，让AI真正理解数据的业务含义，从而给出可信可审计的回复

它解决几个问题，大模型会查表但不懂业务口径

比如说，“上季度华东收入多少”，数据库里没有一个叫“华东收入”的字段

模型需要知道收入是由哪些字段计算、华东对应哪些地区、时间字段应该用下单日发货日还是开票日、哪些表能连哪些不能连

Auto-Ontology就是先把这些定义整理出来，让模型按已认证口径查询

还一个，数据分析师在重复解释上浪费时间

“这个收入为什么不等于财务报表里的收入”、“这张表应该和哪张表连”等等

Auto-Ontology就可以把这些重复知识固化成可查询、可审核、可复用的语义层，减少每个AI、每个用户都重新猜一遍的情况

核心工作流包括这几步：
1、Discover自动发现数据结构
读取数据库元数据，识别业务实体、字段、关系以及潜在的语义关联

2、Ground语义落地
把“客户”“订单”“收入”等业务术语映射到具体表和列

3、Certify人工认证
业务人员可以检查、修正业务术语、SQL指标以及表关系，对经过核验的语义定义进行认证和管理

4、Validate校验查询
查询前先判断当前数据是否真的支持这个问题，比如计算广告回报率时，如果缺少广告支出数据，它会要求澄清，不是说硬算一个广告回报率

最大的价值应该是它把“企业数据是什么意思”从分析师脑子里的隐性经验，变成了AI可调用、可认证、可审计的基础设施

你的销售Agent、财务Agent、运营Agent也不必各自盲猜含义，可以基于统一的业务定义理解查询数据

Siri 终于即将能调用第三方的 APP 去完成任务了！

苹果发布了一个更新叫 App Intents，所有开发者都可以将自己的 APP 功能接入 Siri AI 了。

你可以自由决定将哪些功能开放给 Siri AI 去控制。

Siri AI 的接入加上之前 iPhone Duo的适配，给很多大厂超级应用提出了难题。

之前豆包在手机上的时候，国内基本上这些超级应用都拒绝了豆包自动操作它们的应用。

现在 Siri AI 也有类似的功能了，到时候可以看看它们的应对，应该会很有意思。

这个能力的大概介绍：

打车之后，让 Siri 帮你改上车地点，或者让 Siri 帮你挑选对应 APP 里收藏的商品。

Siri AI 也可以跨 APP 工作，比如将某一个收藏的商品，从一个购物软件里发送给聊天软件的朋友。

还内置了一个 Agent 的 Skill 格式的子集。Siri 会先看 Skill，再判断用户的请求是否匹配，然后读正文。Skill 会给 Siri 提供指导，比如它应该怎么操作，哪些东西能做，哪些东西不能做。

现在开发者可以从 27.3 测试版开始去测试。

fullText:
Linear Algebra and Optimization for Machine Learning [516-page textbook]: https://t.co/LH2L8FyKGr
—
This textbook is organized around its 2 main themes:
[Amazon Summary]

1. Linear algebra and its applications: The chapters focus on the basics of linear algebra together with their common applications to singular value decomposition, matrix factorization, similarity matrices (kernel methods), and graph analysis. Numerous machine learning applications have been used as examples, such as spectral clustering, kernel-based classification, and outlier detection. The tight integration of linear algebra methods with examples from machine learning differentiates this book from generic volumes on linear algebra. The focus is clearly on the most relevant aspects of linear algebra for machine learning and to teach readers how to apply these concepts.

2. Optimization and its applications: Much of machine learning is posed as an optimization problem in which we try to maximize the accuracy of regression and classification models. The “parent problem” of optimization-centric machine learning is least-squares regression. Interestingly, this problem arises in both linear algebra and optimization, and is one of the key connecting problems of the two fields. Least-squares regression is also the starting point for support vector machines, logistic regression, and recommender systems. Furthermore, the methods for dimensionality reduction and matrix factorization also require the development of optimization methods. A general view of optimization in computational graphs is discussed together with its applications to back propagation in neural networks.
